subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1
solution:
The correct answer is '**preach**' (option 2).

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The context of the passage is discussing what religions teach or advocate for, focusing on good conduct.
 
• The word "preach" is the most appropriate choice as it means to advocate or promote, which fits the context of religions promoting good conduct.
 
• Other options ("**abandon**,” "**refrain**,” and "**depart**”) do not convey the idea of advocating or teaching good conduct.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage: *We should remember that all religions (1) preach__ good conduct in life, the foundation of which should rest on (2) __morality__. Without the basis of morality, philosophy would remain mere polemics, and religion would be (3) __fruitless__ and vain. Nobody can say that he is religious unless he is (4) __moral__ and unselfish. It is realised that by constant endeavour through thought, word and deed, one could (5) __achieve__ absolute peace of mind.* 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Abandon**: This means to leave or give up, which does not fit the context.
 
• **Refrain**: This means to hold back or abstain from, which does not fit the context.
 
• **Depart**: This means to leave, which does not fit the context.
